properties.description:
Provide a children Node list and selected child Node editor at template/space/channel levels as appropriate. Default opens Default -> Private. Remove the redundant outer Buildspace configuration panel identified by the user.

Progress: navigation is now a configured frontend contributor in the owning local engine. Template, space and channel levels display the reusable Node list / Node editor, including common Copy URL tools. The redundant Buildspace configuration wrapper is removed. The Broccoli icon opens the template list; hover shows the complete unpinned navigation tree. Focused browser recordings pass for overview geometry, full-tree navigation, independent/shared frontend contributors, unsaved draft guards and Recovery. Remaining integration includes dynamic space membership and context-scoped header content.

Slice verification completed: Canonical navigation nodes now feed the shared children list and selected-node editor at each navigation level. The extra Buildspace configuration wrapper is removed. Navigation/geometry recordings pass and their screenshots were inspected.
properties.title: Show children and selected-node editing at navigation levels
